title: SessionCancelQueuedPrompt
description: Takes a prompt out of the session's queue before it starts. Any watcher may, as any may send one. The outcome is `prompt.dequeued` with `reason: cancelled`, for everybody watching. A prompt that already started is `CONFLICT` (`session.error.queuedPromptStarted`); one the queue never had is `QUEUED_PROMPT_NOT_FOUND`.
